Ammonia loads tweaks into apps on macOS. Lisa and other tweaks in this repo need it.

This package installs Ammonia's own release package from [GitHub](https://github.com/MachLiberation/Ammonia/releases) unchanged.

### Restart required
Restart your Mac after installing. Tweaks load only after the restart.

### What it changes
- Adds the `-arm64e_preview_abi` boot argument (other boot arguments are kept).
- Turns off library validation system-wide, so apps can load tweaks that aren't signed by Apple. This lowers your Mac's protection against injected code.
- Installs the `com.bedtime.ammonia` launch daemon.

Removing Ammonia deletes its files and daemon but leaves the boot argument and the library validation setting as they are.
